doc: Transform of an outfit layer canvas (288x416 webp in public/mascot/outfits) onto the 512x512 expression avatar image. x,y: top-left of the layer canvas in avatar pixels (may be negative); scale: layer pixel -> avatar pixel; rotation: degrees clockwise about the layer centre. Front layer file per mood: neutral '-front', happy '-front-happy', oops '-front-oops'. Layer order: back (laurel only), avatar, front. Source of truth: this file is imported by src/components/avatar/AvatarLook.tsx. `disabled`: pairs checked by eye on the 2026-10-10 art (image_key tera_a_*) where a lens misses an eye on the 3/4 views; the layer is not drawn there. Crown may sit in front of the crest.
